tools.name: validate_vat
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT number (27 member states + XI Northern Ireland). Normalizes the input, checks the national format and checksum locally, then queries VIES (European Commission) live with limited retries. status: valid | invalid (local checksum/format failed, or VIES answered valid=false) | unverif

tools.name: agent_readiness_check
tools.description: Deterministically grade an MCP tool catalog or a third-party x402 endpoint. Provide exactly one of: mcp_url (public https MCP server; initialize + tools/list), x402_url (public https resource; the gateway requests it WITHOUT an X-PAYMENT header and reads the 402), or tools (a JSON tool manifest).
